text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, the 
pedestrian light just ahead of Air Groove 
and me began to blink.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I suppose we shall wait.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry!! You can still make it in 
time!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmh? That voice is—

Suddenly, Taiki Shuttle sped past right 
beside me, dashing straight across the 
crosswalk.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yay! Safe by a hair!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You made it in the nick of time, YES!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Taiki!! Stay right there!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What!? Why is Air Groove here!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A flashing red light means you shouldn't 
cross anymore. And yet you dashed across 
at full speed...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Listen up, you lack awareness!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you wear that uniform, outside 
the academy you are seen not as an 
individual, but as the academy itself!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your actions and behavior all reflect back 
on the academy, and in turn, on the 
reputation of all Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Sowwy. I'm reflecting on what I did..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If you truly regret it, I won't say any 
more on the matter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I catch you doing it again, you'll be 
writing an apology letter. Consider 
yourself warned.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes sir... I mean, yes, ma'am!

Saying so, Taiki Shuttle briskly left the 
area.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, I wonder if they truly 
understood...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Umamusume possess higher 
physical abilities than humans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even a minor bump for us could result in 
serious injuries if we collide with a 
human.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"To prevent such a situation, each of us 
must maintain a strong sense of 
discipline."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want to cause any ill will 
between humans and Umamusume, after all.

Air Groove stated resolutely, and followed 
with a quiet, firm nod.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You too?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to say the badge shining on 
your lapel is nothing more than a 
decoration?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're in a position to guide the 
students, and yet you... Argh, we're going 
home!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once we return, I shall lecture you 
thoroughly until you develop some actual 
awareness as an instructor!

Afterward, just as she promised, I 
received a thorough and unrelenting 
lecture.
